entries.place: The gravel drive outside the Redmist Estate gate
entries.what_happened: Carla introduced herself as Julian's bodyguard, said his safety was her top priority, and asked to borrow his phone. Julian gave his name and asked what she would do with it. She said she would run a threat assessment — contacts, accounts, anything exposed — with nothing deleted and nothing leaving her hands, and he could watch. Julian kept the phone in his own hand and unlocked only what she needed. In the login history they found an entry from three days earlier, after Julian booked his train, from somewhere near the estate; Julian said he had told no one but his mother he was coming. Carla told him to lock the phone and keep the history, and explained the master key: one passcode Bernard held that opens every estate lock, to be handed to Julian in a witnessed procedure run by Jezebel. She said the login suggested someone knew the handoff was coming, and that Jezebel did not yet know about the login.

Walking to the gatehouse, Julian asked how the procedure could be compromised and whether Jezebel knew of the login. Carla said Jezebel did not know yet and that the login was theirs to hold for a day; she trusted Jezebel as an ally but considered the room, the witnesses and the lawyer Campion suspect until she had seen the procedure. Inside the gatehouse, which smelled of coffee and gun oil and had monitors showing the drive, the rear service road and the pier gate, Carla advised telling Jezebel straight that the key needed a review before the handoff, omitting why Julian had started caring that week, and letting her assume nerves. She said Jezebel's office was in the east wing and they left before anyone else could tell her about the login.

entries.place: The marble hallway of the mansion
entries.what_happened: Julian agreed to play the nervous heir and told Carla that if Jezebel's account of the procedure differed from what Carla remembered, that was Carla's cue to speak, not his; Carla agreed. In the marble hallway Gabriella, dressed in a lavender gown and pearls, stepped out and offered to show Julian the house, remarking on Carla trailing him. Julian declined evenly, saying he had business with Jezebel about finances and paperwork first and would walk the house on his own time. Gabriella mentioned a draft in the east wing, said she would be in the west parlor that afternoon, and went back upstairs. Carla told Julian there was no draft in the east wing and that it was either a warning or a lure; Julian said they would not bite today, and they continued toward Jezebel's office.

entries.place: Jezebel's office in the east wing
entries.what_happened: Julian knocked and Jezebel let him and Carla in. Julian asked to understand the accounts and foundations and to see the master-key handoff end to end before setting a new code, admitting he was new and worried. Jezebel described the procedure: the vault room off the old dispensary, lawyer Campion and herself as witnesses, a new code set on the spot from a sealed slip only Bernard had read, the slip destroyed afterwards, an hour in all. Asked who had told him, Julian said an old friend of Bernard's who knew how he thought. He then asked whether anyone else had ever handled the slip; Jezebel recalled a retired locksmith who serviced the mechanism four years earlier with the door propped open and the slip in hand, a visit she had signed off on. She asked what he feared in that room, and Julian revealed the login from three days ago, before he had told anyone in Islaport he was coming, and asked whom Bernard would have trusted with knowledge of the key. Jezebel named Bernard's dead brother Edmund, Campion the solicitor, and Marguerite, Bernard's nurse of his last two years, to whom he told things he would not tell Jezebel. She said Bernard wrote everything down in a log in the bottom drawer of his private desk in the study, which she had never opened, and that Julian might now have cause to.
